Subject: ClearSight POC: proposed success criteria & next steps

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and a proposed POC plan so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and ownership. I pulled this together based on our call with you, Emma (data), and the ops team.

Summary of needs:
- Goal: Reduce inference cost and 95th percentile latency for batch reporting and interactive analytics dashboards.
- Workloads: daily batch of ~3M tokens (end-of-day scoring) + interactive dashboard queries (50-200 tokens per request, peak concurrency ~30).
- Security: data must stay in VPC; we’ll use your S3 staging buckets + KMS key.

Proposed POC (3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (kickoff, access) — Confirm data access, sandbox creds, and success metrics.
2) Week 1 (integration) — Connect ClearSight staging data; validate end-to-end inference; baseline performance.
3) Week 2 (optimize & evaluate) — Apply batching, KV caching, and try one quantized variant; run benchmark set.
4) Week 3 (wrap & handoff) — Review results, confirm pass/fail vs success criteria, next steps for production.

Proposed success criteria (anything 1+ must be met):
- Latency: interactive 95th <= 250ms on your staging hardware (95th measured over a 2-hour peak window).
- Cost: per-token unit cost <= target (we estimate ~35% reduction via batching & caching vs baseline).
- Quality: top-line metric — no more than 3% relative regression in your accuracy KPI (field-level scoring).
- Ops: automated fallback configured and smoke tests pass in your staging.

Owners & immediate asks:
- ClearSight owner: Tom Reynolds (data team) — confirm access to sample dataset and staging S3 path by EOD Thu (3/4).
- Procurement: please loop procurement@clearsight.com for MOU/contract items.
- Redwood owner: Marissa (PM, sales) + Marcus (AE) + Rishi (SE) for technical setup.

Attachments: attached a short POC runbook and MOU draft for procurement to review (clearsight-poc-runbook.pdf, clearsight-mou-draft.docx).

Next steps:
- Can we confirm kickoff on Tue 3/8 at 10:00am PT?
- Please confirm sample data S3 path and the KMS key we should use.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary and the runbook. This looks right directionally. A few notes from our side after syncing with Emma and Ops:

- Timeline: 3 weeks is fine but prefer that Week 1 (integration) focuses on the batch pipeline first (we ship daily scoring). If that looks good we’ll run interactive queries in Week 2.
- Success metrics: for quality we measure AUC at the model output. Can we make the quality gate: AUC drop <= 0.02 absolute rather than relative? That maps better to our dashboards.
- Security: we’ll provide a staging S3 path (s3://clearsight-staging/poc/) and our KMS ARN. I’ll share credentials via our secrets team once procurement signs MOU.

Procurement (cc) — I’ll ask procurement to review the MOU draft and come back with redlines.

Kickoff: Tue 3/8 10:00am PT works for our team.

Tom
